races.paceDynamic: Krasimir is the clear front-runner having led successfully over this course and distance before, with Ocean Echo and Suspicious Mindz likely to track him closely from prominent positions. The pace should be genuine but not destructive, as there's limited early speed beyond the leader with most of the field drawn to settle further back. The moderate gallop will create a tactical affair where horses need to be positioned handy to the pace, as many hold-up performers like Zenford, Al Haarith and Motta Alta could get caught behind traffic in a large 17-runner field. This race shape clearly favours prominent racers and those with tactical pace to sit close to the leaders.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Tactical Pace Battle
scenarios.trigger: If Krasimir leads but gets challenged by Ocean Echo or Suspicious Mindz through the middle stages
scenarios.body: The pace quickens enough to set up the race properly but doesn't collapse, allowing horses with proven tactical speed to strike. Those who can track the leaders and have a change of gear benefit most from this measured but honest gallop.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Krasimir gets an easy lead with minimal pressure from the prominent horses
scenarios.body: The pace becomes too slow and tactical, allowing the experienced front-runner to dictate terms and kick clear when ready. Hold-up horses get caught flat-footed by the lack of pace and can't make up ground when it matters.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Newcomer Surprise Package
scenarios.trigger: If the well-bred debutants Green Amoro or Elusive Path show significant ability on debut
scenarios.body: The race develops into a proper test where raw talent can overcome experience, particularly from horses with strong pedigrees. The Lyons and O'Brien newcomers could have the class edge over exposed maidens.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Late Closer Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuinely strong with Krasimir being pressed hard by multiple prominent runners
scenarios.body: The pace collapses in the final furlong creating opportunities for hold-up horses with finishing kicks. Zenford or Al Haarith could benefit from a truly-run race that sets up their closing style.

watchPoints.text: Al Haarith could be very hard to beat if wound up after his long absence, given his Group 2-level juvenile form
Krasimir may get uncontested lead as the only confirmed front-runner, which would make him very dangerous
Green Amoro and Elusive Path represent powerful stables on debut and should be monitored for market confidence
Traffic problems likely in 17-runner field will particularly hurt hold-up horses like Zenford and Motta Alta
Ocean Echo's much-improved latest effort over this trip suggests he's found his ideal conditions

races.paceDynamic: Kindergarten and County Carlow will ensure strong early pace as both are confirmed front runners with recent leading victories. Ocean's Breath and Breaking Dawn will track closely behind this pace battle, while the hold-up horses Luna Mia and Substance will need the leaders to maintain their gallop. The dual pace angle creates an honest tempo that should see the early leaders soften up. This race shape clearly favours prominent runners who can track the pace and kick - those sitting just off the leaders will have the tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Ocean's Breath and Breaking Dawn can track the early pace battle effectively
scenarios.body: The dual front runners Kindergarten and County Carlow will soften each other up, allowing those sitting just behind to inherit the race. Prominent runners get the perfect tow into the straight and can quicken when the leaders tire.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Kindergarten or County Carlow can establish a clear early lead without serious pressure
scenarios.body: One of the pace-setters breaks clear of their rival and controls the tempo, maintaining enough energy for a strong finish. The hold-up horses face too much to do against a controlled pace.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace battle between Kindergarten and County Carlow becomes overly aggressive
scenarios.body: Both front runners burn each other out in a fierce early battle, creating perfect conditions for closers. Luna Mia or Substance benefit from the strong gallop and finish powerfully from the back.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If both Kindergarten and County Carlow fail to maintain their usual aggressive tactics
scenarios.body: The race becomes tactical with no genuine pace-setter emerging from the start. This creates a sprint finish where natural speed and positioning matter more than stamina.

Luna Mia making seasonal debut after 237 days off, fitness could be a question mark despite home work

Substance could benefit most if the two front runners go too hard early and collapse

races.paceDynamic: Howd'yadoit will lead or race prominently early with the prominent runners Tina's Indian and Little Queenie tracking close behind, while the hold-up horses Tango Flare, Alibah, Gazelle d'Or and She's Too Kool settle towards the rear. With only one confirmed front-runner in a small field of seven, the pace will be sustainable rather than searching, allowing the leaders to dictate terms through steady fractions. The hold-up horses will need to produce sharp acceleration from the back to overhaul what could be a strong position up front. This race shape clearly favours the prominent runners who can sit close to the pace and avoid the need for spectacular closing kicks.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Control
scenarios.trigger: If Howd'yadoit sets steady fractions without being harassed early
scenarios.body: The pace setters maintain their advantage as the hold-up horses struggle to make up ground in the straight. Tina's Indian and Little Queenie can track the leader and have first run, while the closers find themselves with too much to do.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Strong Closer Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes pedestrian and bunches the field
scenarios.body: Tango Flare or Gazelle d'Or produces a devastating late surge to pick up the pieces. The sustainable pace plays into the hands of the best finisher who can time their run to perfection.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Howd'yadoit goes too fast early trying to make all
scenarios.body: The leader comes back to the field in the final furlong as the hold-up horses benefit from strong pace. Alibah and She's Too Kool get the perfect setup to unleash finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Upset from Outsider
scenarios.trigger: If the market leaders fail to fire or face traffic problems
scenarios.body: Little Queenie or She's Too Kool capitalizes on a messy race where the favourites encounter trouble. The race becomes tactical and suits a horse coming from an unexpected position.

races.paceDynamic: La La Lucrative is the sole confirmed front-runner and will face no early pressure, allowing her to dictate a sustainable tempo through the opening half-mile. The prominent racers like Verhoyen, I'm Spartacus, and Whatswrongnow will sit just behind but won't rush to engage early. This creates a perfect setup where the pace builds gradually, leaving plenty in reserve for a sprint finish over the final two furlongs. This race shape strongly favors hold-up horses who can deliver their challenge late, as the modest early gallop will ensure the field stays bunched and the race becomes a dash from the 2f pole.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Lead Pays
scenarios.trigger: If La La Lucrative gets an easy lead and the field allows her too much rope early
scenarios.body: She can dictate fractions that suit her stamina and kick clear when the challenges come, having conserved energy while others sprint past each other. Her recent Listowel win shows she has the class when things fall right.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Heroes Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly pedestrian and the field bunches into the straight
scenarios.body: The closers get the perfect setup to unleash their finishing kicks against tiring leaders who've been eyeballing each other. Polar Bear and Andosky can use their late speed to maximum effect.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Pounces
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners positions perfectly and times their move to perfection
scenarios.body: Whatswrongnow or I'm Spartacus can sit close enough to strike when La La Lucrative begins to tire, but far enough back to have something left. The winner comes from just off the pace rather than the extremes.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Late
scenarios.trigger: If La La Lucrative stops abruptly under the penalty and the prominent runners also empty out
scenarios.body: The race becomes a complete lottery where any horse with a late kick can sweep up the pieces. Even unfancied hold-up types can emerge from nowhere when the pace scenario implodes.

races.paceDynamic: Antigua is the only confirmed front runner in this field and should get an uncontested lead with no other pace pressure identified. The moderate early gallop will allow prominent runners like Noble Honour to sit comfortably in second, while the large hold-up contingent including Pierre Grosse, Big Cypress, and Trustmore will be bunched at the back. With good ground conditions favoring stamina and the lack of early pace, this race strongly favors hold-up horses who can produce sustained finishing kicks over the final 3-4 furlongs.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Antigua sets a steady pace without pressure and the field comes home in a bunch
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace allows closers to unleash powerful finishing kicks, with Pierre Grosse's proven form and Big Cypress's O'Brien stable strength coming to the fore. Trustmore's strong finishing efforts in previous runs also suit this scenario perfectly.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Noble Honour can track Antigua's moderate pace and kick clear before the hold-up horses arrive
scenarios.body: The Harrington filly gets first run on the field from her prominent position while the back markers are still winding up their challenges. Her fitness advantage from recent runs gives her the edge in a sustained battle.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Newcomer Spring Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If one of the debutants Giordano, Noble Venture, or Shewillow shows significant improvement from breeding
scenarios.body: The moderate pace allows an unexposed runner to show their true ability, with Giordano's Cotai Glory breeding or Noble Venture's Dandy Man connections producing the goods. The lack of early pressure means they won't be found out for experience.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Antigua improves significantly for the step up in trip and maintains a strong gallop throughout
scenarios.body: The Ballydoyle runner uses his uncontested lead to build an unassailable advantage, with his previous fourth places suggesting ability that could flourish over this longer distance. The field fails to mount a serious challenge despite the moderate pace.

races.paceDynamic: Ella's Gold is the only confirmed front runner and will dictate from the start with minimal early pressure in this 16-runner field. She's Ideal and Barretstown may press from prominent positions, while the majority including Sweet Baby Zou, Amavasya, and Onyeisi will settle in behind. With most runners preferring to come from off the pace and Ella's Gold likely getting soft fractions, this sets up perfectly for hold-up horses to deliver late challenges. This race shape strongly favours hold-up performers who can close from midfield or rear positions.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Ella's Gold gets uncontested soft fractions up front
scenarios.body: The lone pace-setter controls the tempo and kicks clear in the straight while the hold-up brigade leaves their runs too late. Front runners and prominent racers benefit from the tactical advantage of dictating terms.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Closers Swamp Leader
scenarios.trigger: If the pace proves too slow for Ella's Gold to sustain her kick
scenarios.body: The field bunches up turning for home and the race becomes a sprint finish where the freshest hold-up horses sweep past the tiring leader. This strongly favours horses with proven finishing kicks from off the pace.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Pressers Take Over
scenarios.trigger: If She's Ideal and Barretstown press Ella's Gold throughout
scenarios.body: The early pace quickens as prominent runners force the issue, setting up a scenario where horses tracking the leaders can pounce. Mid-division runners who avoided the early battle benefit most from this honest gallop.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Ella's Gold goes too slow and no one challenges early
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy sprint from the home turn where any horse with a turn of foot can win regardless of position. This chaos scenario can throw up any result but slightly favours those with natural speed.

watchPoints.text: Watch Ella's Gold's early fractions as she's the only pace-setter returning from a 228-day absence

races.paceDynamic: Copper Craft is the only confirmed pace-setter but faces little early pressure, meaning he can dictate comfortable fractions through the early stages. My Kurkum may press but lacks the form to sustain pressure, while the remaining 15 runners are all hold-up horses who will settle behind. This creates a tactical nightmare with too many horses needing luck in running and room to manoeuvre in the straight. The uncontested early pace heavily favours prominent runners and those with natural early speed who can secure good positions.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Copper Craft sets steady fractions without pressure and stays the trip
scenarios.body: The lone pace-setter controls the race completely and has enough left to resist the wall of closers who struggle for racing room. Too many hold-up horses create traffic problems behind.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Early Pace Collapses
scenarios.trigger: If Copper Craft stops quickly or gets headed early by improvers
scenarios.body: The pace becomes falsely run creating a sprint finish where horses with natural speed can overcome poor positions. Those closest to the pace inherit a tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Hero Finds Gap
scenarios.trigger: If the favourite Deuteronomy or another strong closer gets a clear run
scenarios.body: Superior class tells despite the tactical disadvantage as the best horse navigates traffic successfully. Recent winner's confidence proves decisive in a driving finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Meltdown
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses challenge Copper Craft early creating genuine pace pressure
scenarios.body: Strong early gallop sets up perfectly for the closers but only those with proven finishing kicks can capitalise. The field comes back to the best stayers.

watchPoints.text: Copper Craft must be monitored early as the only pace angle - if he breaks slowly or gets headed immediately the race dynamic changes completely
Watch the market for La Campanella and Yquem who are both returning from breaks under new connections and could be primed
Swift Charm deserves respect after career-best effort at Ballinrobe where the fourth and sixth have won since
Check if any hold-up horses show early intent to press Copper Craft as this would transform the pace scenario
Monitor Deuteronomy for signs of the 7lb weight rise affecting his action given he needs career-best form to win
